title: Daga farashi zuwa farashin da ya dace, kuma menene rangwamen farashi da gaske

say: Daga farashi zuwa farashin da ya dace, kuma menene rangwamen farashi da gaske.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 2 na Gabatarwa zuwa Farashi da Siyar.
A cikin Module 1 kun sami ainihin farashin ku. Yanzu kun juya shi zuwa farashi.
Farashi da ƙari yana farawa daga farashin ku kuma yana ƙara zaɓin kashi. Yana gaya muku mafi ƙarancin farashi da zaku iya karɓa.

card.title: Abin da 10% ya kashe da gaske yana kashe Ngozi

say: Idan Ngozi ta ba da kashi 10%, farashinta ya ragu da Naira 80 zuwa Naira 720. Kudinta ya tsaya, don haka ribarta ta ragu daga naira 250 zuwa 170. Ta yi asarar kashi 32% na ribar da ta samu a wannan fakitin.

card.title: Abin da 10% ya kashe da gaske yana kashe Ngozi

say: Anan shine ƙarin ka'idar tallace-tallace. Raba tsohuwar riba da sabon riba. 250 ya raba ta 170 shine 1.47.
Don haka idan ta saba sayar da fakiti 100 a mako, dole ne ta sayar da fakiti kusan 147 don kawai ta tsaya.

say: Ba da rangwame kawai lokacin da aka biya ta ta ainihin tanadi, kamar bayarwa ɗaya don oda mai yawa. Abun kyauta yana biyan ku kuɗin sa, ba farashinsa ba, don haka siyan 10 sami 1 kyauta zai iya doke kashi 10%.
Saita iyakokin lokaci, rubuta farashin tafiya, kuma kada ku taɓa ƙasa da benen ku.

say: Don tunawa. Farashin gefe ta hanyar raba farashi da 1 ban da gefe. Alamar alama da gefe ba iri ɗaya ba ne.
Farashin yana saita bene, masu fafatawa suna nuna kewayon, kuma suna sanya ku ƙima a ciki. Rangwamen yana fitowa daga riba, don haka duba ƙarin tallace-tallace da za ku buƙaci farko.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Farashin gefe = farashin da aka raba ta (1 rabe rabe)
Markup shine riba akan farashi; ribar riba ne akan farashi
Farashin yana saita bene, masu fafatawa da iyaka, darajar wurin ku
Rangwamen yana fitowa daga riba, ba farashi ba
Ƙarin tallace-tallace da ake buƙata = tsohuwar ribar da aka raba ta sabon riba
